result.description: A fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for quiet office work, reading, and creative layout tasks. It features a QHD IPS panel, 2560 x 1440 resolution, 75 Hz refresh rate, 350 nits brightness, anti-glare coating, and integrated dual 3 W speakers. Connectivity includes HDMI, DisplayPort, and USB-C with 65 W power delivery. The stand supports tilt, swivel, pivot, and height adjustment for ergonomic setups.
